# Mesh SDK Tmux fixtures

Six frozen Read v1 examples copied byte-for-byte from Mesh Plus commit
`9d570c59041832d177519fd634d26c56ed572e81`, `contracts/mesh-read-v1/examples/`.
`SHA256SUMS` binds these inputs. Expected native projections and effective rows
come from the separately installed a10 research baseline in
the fixture provenance recorded in Git.
Reserved WSS examples are outside this integration.
